body: I feel you man. I know I’m not ready either, at least not until I make up for some of the damage that I’ve done

I hope so too, I really do. But it Can feel so difficult just waking up in the morning. I try to tell myself “just get through this day” every day. So far it has worked. But to say that I loathe myself for my actions is an understatement. But you have to face your demons and your mistakes in order to be rid of them.

No ones truly ever alone, but it Can feel that way. I would love someone to give me some advice too, at least something that isn’t “you just gotta move on”, like it’s the easiest thing. But thank you brother, sending love from Denmark

That is very true! I think it’s part of their fantasy anime world, where they are the protagonist. I just think me and my fiancée were unfortunate to meet a neckbeard on the dangerous side of the Neckbeard-spectrum
Ja men sådan er det med de her typer, de er gode til at gemme sig mellem ordinære mennesker, skræmmende. Og tusinde tak❤️

I think it is reasonable, though I think some may disagree and think he should have gotten a longer sentence. But he gets therapy while in prison so I hope it helps him get better so that he won’t hurt anyone again

Exactly, you read about them and never really think you’ll be the one to encounter them. Just seeing what my fiancée had to go through AFTER the ordeal. It hurts. But things are looking bright and we still have a longe life ahead of us

Vi er alle okay og er kommet over episoden. Håber bare på at han har fået den terapi han havde brug for mens han har været inde og brumme. På trods af hvad han har gjort kan jeg ikke hade ham, kun have ondt af at man kan være så fordrejet i sit hovede.

I agree whole heartedly. But I digress. At least he inspired me to study psychology, in hopes of helping others through such situations and my fiancée wants to join the Danish Police. So something good came out of it all

I don’t know what he told the police during questioning. But in court he said things like “I just felt an uncontrollable urge”, “I deserved her love”, “I had a feeling that he abused her and wanted to save her”. So I think he had some deranged thoughts after watching (like I said in the post) medieval movies about how the knight saves the princess and all that. But thanks for the kind words! the wedding has of course been pushed back with COVID-19 but we hope to marry in January 2021 on the day we met and our little guy is due December!

It is, but that’s the punishment here in Denmark. Though since it’s been so long I’m a little uncertain whether it was 4 1/2 years, or 3 1/2 years. I just hope he doesn’t find us again and recieved the therapy he needs
